{"output": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = Path.home() / "hermes-logs-sync"
SOURCE = Path("/sdcard/Download/ChatGPT-Logs")
DEST = REPO / "logs"
OUT = DEST / "tool-results"

SENSITIVE_KEY = re.compile(
    r"(api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|"
    r"client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|secret|authorization|cookie)",
    re.I,
)

PATTERNS = [
    (r"-----BEGIN [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----.*?-----END [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----",
     "[PRIVATE KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", re.S),
    (r"(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+",
     "Bearer [TOKEN DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"(?i)([\"']?(?:api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|secret|authorization|cookie|set-cookie)[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?)[^\"'\s,}\]]+",
     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"(?i)(--(?:api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)\s+)[^\s]+",
     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"\b(?:ghp_|gho_|ghu_|ghs_|github_pat_|sk-proj-|sk-ant-|sk-)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b",
     "[TOKEN DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}\b",
     "[GOOGLE KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b",
     "[AWS KEY DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
    (r"(?i)([?&](?:token|api_key|key|password|secret)=)[^&\s]+",
     r"\1[DISEMBUNYIKAN]", 0),
]

def clean_text(value):
    value = str(value)
    for pattern, replacement, flags in PATTERNS:
        value = re.sub(pattern, replacement, value, flags=flags)
    return value

def clean_data(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {
            str(k): ("[DISEMBUNYIKAN]" if SENSITIVE_KEY.search(str(k))
                     else clean_data(v))
            for k, v in value.items()
        }
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [clean_data(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return clean_text(value)
    return value

def run(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        args, cwd=REPO, check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True
    )

def main():
    if not (REPO / ".git").is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError("Repository Hermes logs tidak ditemukan")

    raw = sys.stdin.read()
    if not raw.strip():
        raise RuntimeError("Payload hook kosong")

    payload = json.loads(raw)
    if payload.get("hook_event_name") != "post_tool_call":
        print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "ignored_event"}))
        return
    if payload.get("tool_name") != "terminal":
        print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "ignored_tool"}))
        return

    extra = payload.get("extra") or {}
    timestamp = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

    record = clean_data({
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "event": payload.get("hook_event_name"),
        "tool": payload.get("tool_name"),
        "session_id": payload.get("session_id"),
        "cwd": payload.get("cwd"),
        "command": payload.get("tool_input"),
        "status": extra.get("status") or ("error" if extra.get("error_type") or extra.get("error_message") else "ok"),
        "duration_ms": extra.get("duration_ms"),
        "error_type": extra.get("error_type"),
        "error_message": extra.get("error_message"),
        "result": extra.get("result"),
    })

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    daily = OUT / f"calls-{datetime.now().astimezone():%Y%m%d}.jsonl"
    with daily.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")

    latest = [
        "Hermes — hasil tool terminal",
        f"Waktu: {record['timestamp']}",
        f"Status: {record['status']}",
        f"Durasi: {record['duration_ms']} ms",
        f"Direktori: {record['cwd']}",
        "",
        "PERINTAH:",
        json.dumps(record["command"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        "",
        "HASIL:",
        record["result"] if isinstance(record["result"], str)
        else json.dumps(record["result"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str),
        "",
    ]
    (OUT / "latest.txt").write_text(
        clean_text("\n".join(latest)), encoding="utf-8"
    )

    if SOURCE.is_dir():
        for src in SOURCE.glob("*.txt"):
            if src.is_file() and not src.is_symlink():
                (DEST / src.name).write_text(
                    clean_text(src.read_text(errors="replace")),
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )

    run("git", "add", "--", "logs")
    changed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "diff", "--cached", "--quiet"], cwd=REPO
    ).returncode

    if changed == 0:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "no_changes"}))
        return
    if changed != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Pemeriksaan perubahan Git gagal")

    run("git", "commit", "-m", "Sync Hermes terminal results")
    run("git", "push", "origin", "main")
    print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "action": "pushed"}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"SYNC ERROR: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)", "exit_code": 0, "error": null}
